citations.short: Review of representative number of batches
citations.long: Written procedures are not followed for evaluations conducted at least annually to review records associated with a representative number of batches, whether approved or rejected.

citations.short: Approve or reject procedures or specs
citations.long: The quality control unit lacks responsibility to approve and reject all procedures or specifications impacting on the identity, strength, quality, and purity of drug products.
Equipment and utensils are not cleaned at appropriate intervals to prevent contamination that would alter the safety, identity, strength, quality or purity of the drug product.

citations.short: Control procedures to monitor and validate performance
citations.long: Control procedures are not established which monitor the output and validate the performance of those manufacturing processes that may be responsible for causing variability in the characteristics of in-process material and the drug product.

Acceptance criteria for the sampling and testing conducted by the quality control unit is not adequate to assure that batches of drug products meet each appropriate specification as a condition for their approval and release.

citations.short: Annual visual exams of drug products
citations.long: Reserve samples from representative sample lots or batches of drug products selected by acceptable statistical procedures are not examined visually at least once a year for evidence of deterioration.
Complaint procedures are deficient in that written complaint records are not maintained in a file designated for drug product complaints.

Adverse drug experience information obtained or otherwise received from any source was not promptly reviewed, including information from commercial marketing experience, post marketing epidemiological/surveillance activities, and reports in the scientific literature.
Not all periodic reports contained an FDA Form 3500A for each adverse drug experience not reported as a post marketing 15-day Alert report.
